newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says M4 boosted by special factors.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says M4 boosted by special factors.

text.p: The British Treasury said on Thursday growth in British August M4 money supply data had been boosted by special factors.

"August growth appears to be boosted by a number of special factors, including the National & Provincial payout and also comes after lower growth in July," a British Treasury official said after release of money supply data.
Adjusted M4 money supply grew 0.9 percent in the month of August and was up 9.4 percent from a year earlier, compared with 9.0 percent year-on-year growth in July.
The National & Provincial building society, whose merger with Abbey National Plc was completed in August, made special payouts to its savers and mortgage holders.
